renderpass.name: Cube A
renderpass.code: void mainCubemap(out vec4 c, in vec2 f, in vec3 ro, in vec3 rd){ c = vec4(0.5+0.5*rd, 1.0); }

renderpass.name: Image
renderpass.code: void mainImage(out vec4 c, in vec2 f){ vec2 uv=(2.0*f-iResolution.xy)/iResolution.y; vec3 rd=normalize(vec3(uv,1.5)); float a=iTime*0.3; rd.xz=mat2(cos(a),-sin(a),sin(a),cos(a))*rd.xz; c = texture(iChannel0, rd); }
